text: Pawn name label floats cut off at the right screen edge ('Frank Br / Ambitio / (looking') when the pawn is beside the player; tick ~2664

Inviting a pawn (R) needs them within 5 m, but wandering pawns move as fast as the player: 5 walkto attempts over ~3000 ticks (ticks 600-3764) mostly ended 'stuck: not getting closer' at 20-50 m. Only one pawn reached, and he had already founded his own nation.

Laws tab at 960x540 shows only Taxes, Conscription, Borders. The game has a fourth law, Rationing (Laws.All), but LawsPanel stops drawing rows when the next block would not fit above the footer, and there is no scroll, so Rationing can never be seen or enacted at this window size.

No screen names the ruler's heir or the line of succession. Nations tab says 'You lead it' only; Laws tab and Player Info say nothing about an heir. A player has no way to know before dying whether the run will end (no heir) or who takes over; with 1 member it would end silently-unwarned.

Repeal worked: Conscription Off and Borders Closed, proclaimed at tick 4172, came into force at tick 6000 (chronicle: 'Northburg stood down its conscripts', 'closed its borders'). That is 36.6 game s against the promised 30 s; the first enactment took 31 s (452->2000). Laws seem to apply on 1000-tick rounds.
